description: I am an Emirati student passionate about space exploration. I aspire to become an astronaut and contribute to the UAE’s space sector. I founded Sands to Stars to develop an educational game simulating a seven-day lunar mission, helping young learners build resource management, decision-making, and problem-solving skills while inspiring their interest in space science.
summary:
Sands to Stars: Lunar Command is an interactive browser game for children aged 7–12. Players manage a lunar outpost over seven simulated days, balancing oxygen, power, and crew protection.

Each day, players choose a plan and watch their astronaut use tools to complete tasks, including cleaning solar panels, improving shelter protection, connecting a backup battery, and transmitting science results. Equipment changes and simple explanations show how each choice affects the base.

The oxygen-generation activity uses a NASA educational resource explaining how electricity releases oxygen from water. All resource percentages are fictional training values.

The game makes engineering trade-offs understandable through play, encouraging resource management, problem-solving, and interest in space exploration. ChatGPT assisted with code, illustrations, English text, and original instrumental music. Sources and AI disclosures are included within the game.
details:
Sands to Stars: Lunar Command is a browser-based educational game for children aged 7–12. Players manage a lunar outpost through seven simulated mission days, balancing oxygen, power, and crew protection.

Each day presents two plans with different benefits and costs. Players choose a plan, watch their astronaut collect a matching tool and complete the task, then see the equipment and resources change. Activities include producing oxygen, cleaning solar panels, reinforcing a shelter, connecting a backup battery, transmitting findings, and checking supplies.

Simple explanations connect each task to its purpose. The astronaut returns tools after working and enters Lunar Haven to remove the suit and rest. Starting the next day shows the astronaut dressing and returning outside. Players earn an explorer badge by completing seven days while keeping essential resources above zero.

NASA’s educational resource about oxygen generation informs the relationship between making oxygen and consuming electricity. Resource percentages and event schedules are fictional training values, not NASA measurements.

The prototype uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SVG illustrations, and original synthesized instrumental audio. It requires no download or player account. Progress saves locally in the browser.

ChatGPT assisted with research, implementation, illustrations, English text, fictional game-balancing values, music, and demonstration-video production. Sources, visible visual watermarks, and AI disclosures are included.
